reason: Added one tagged line (R1) to memory.md: news about a model itself (releases, lab findings on model behavior, reactions to them) is noise unless it gives a concrete change to how an agent is built, run or checked.

Added a memory.md line (R2) that narrows F3: a product launch (hardware SDK, design pack) that only says "point your agent at the repo", or ships a skill for making more of that product, is noise unless it would improve the reader's agent on any project.

Added a memory.md line (R3): a post whose fetch is only a teaser plus "Attached: X article" should not be dropped for being thin; if it is the author's own piece about how agents are built, run or checked, cite it as signal (F2 still applies).

Added a memory.md line (R4): a teaser plus "Attached: X article" should be cited when it is the author's own design for how agents are built, run or checked, but not when it comments on another team's result or predicts its business impact (F2).

Added a memory.md line (R5): judge a post by the author's own words, not by what it attaches; hype or market forecasts are noise even with a harness article attached, and the author's own plan for how agents run, decide or check work is signal even as a short teaser.
